reason: The 64 KiB A-panel proposal is a distinct, coordinated layout and traversal change with a plausible cache-capacity hypothesis, though repacking may erase any benefit. Distance-4 prefetch is a smaller, testable change, but has no evidence of a locality bottleneck. Tail handling and fused transpose affect the general fallback, so they do not directly advance the n=512 target; explicit tail safety is the lower-risk of those two. The ZA remap and indexed addressing have uncertain benefit and higher implementation risk. The joint end-pointer test is close to a previously measured pointer-end variant. The 256-iteration proposal relies on a two-K loop body that the supplied kernel evidence does not show, so its premise needs source confirmation before testing.
